title: Insurer defined.
bodyText: Insurer means every person engaged in the business of making contracts of insurance and includes reciprocal or interinsurance exchanges.

annotations.heading: Attorney General Opinions
annotations.text: The State did not meet definition of insurer in this section. Att. Gen. Op. 95-2.

bodyHtml:
§431:1-202  Insurer defined.  Insurer means every person engaged in the business of making contracts of insurance and includes reciprocal or interinsurance exchanges. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]

 

Attorney General Opinions

 

  The State did not meet definition of insurer in this section.  Att. Gen. Op. 95-2.
